direction: MSR-03 intonation sample: Saul weighs the danger, David answers with quiet conviction, Saul gives a considered blessing. Keep the original cast and words; no voice imitation or pitch shifting.

lines.speaker: Saul
lines.text: You are young. Goliath has fought for years.
lines.delivery: Measured concern, with a thought between David's youth and Goliath's experience.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I have guarded my father's sheep. The Lord who delivered me from lions and bears will help me face him.
lines.delivery: A matter-of-fact first sentence, then a deliberate statement of faith. Confidence without shouting.

phrases.text: I have guarded my father's sheep.
The Lord, who delivered me from lions and bears, will help me face him.

lines.speaker: Saul
lines.text: Go. May the Lord be with you.
lines.delivery: A firm permission followed by a calmer, unhurried benediction.

phrases.text: May the Lord be with you.
